title: Tool error not recovered: write_file scope enforcement (accept_candidate_tests.rs)
description: write_file was rejected with 'exists on disk but has not been read during this run' for src/moeb/src/tools/accept_candidate_tests.rs. The file was newly created in the same run but write_file could not overwrite it without a preceding read_file. The operation was recovered by reading the file first then rewriting; the file content is correct.
proposed_resolution: write_file scope enforcement should not block overwrites of files written earlier in the same run. Run moeb spec to exempt within-run writes from the read-before-write requirement.
